# GrainHero

> AI-powered grain storage management: IoT sensor monitoring, spoilage prediction, alerts and analytics for silos and warehouses.

GrainHero combines in-silo hardware (edge controller, multi-depth probes, LoRa + Wi-Fi) with a SaaS platform that predicts spoilage before it starts and helps operators act early.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, hardware and how the system works.
- [Grain storage monitoring](/solutions/grain-storage-monitoring): What continuous temperature and moisture monitoring measures, safe thresholds, alerting and spoilage prediction.
- [Silo monitoring system](/solutions/silo-monitoring-system): Hardware layers, probe cable and sensor placement by silo size, LoRa connectivity, offline buffering and installation.
- [Grain management software](/solutions/grain-management-software): Batch traceability, silo inventory, role-based access and export-ready condition reporting.
- [About](/about): Mission and company background.
- [Team](/team): The people building GrainHero.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Verified, sensor-monitored grain listings.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the team.
